goals: Verify the performance and success rate of a typical user flow involving getting, creating, commenting, viewing, and liking posts under concurrent load.
activities: Send a GET request to fetch posts
Verify the GET posts response status is 200
Record the GET posts request duration to a trend metric
Pause execution for a specified sleep duration
Send a POST request to create a new post
Verify the create post response status is 200, failing the test if unsuccessful
Record the create post request duration to a trend metric
Extract and parse the created post ID from the response body
Pause execution for a specified sleep duration
Send a POST request to create a comment using the extracted post ID
Verify the create comment response status is 200
Record the create comment request duration to a trend metric
Pause execution for a specified sleep duration
Send a PUT request to add a view to the created post
Verify the view post response status is 200
Record the view post request duration to a trend metric
Pause execution for a specified sleep duration
Send a PUT request to like the created post
Verify the like post response status is 200
Record the like post request duration to a trend metric
